+        delta = read_json(OUT / family["delta"])

+            family_by_part[item["question_part_id"]] = family["family"]
+    by_id = {item["question_part_id"]: item for item in parts}
+    changes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for part_id in RECLAIMED:
+        before = by_id[part_id]
+        after = reclaim_part(before)
+        by_id[part_id] = after
+        shard, _ = RECLAIMED[part_id]
+        family_by_part[part_id] = family_identity(shard)
+        changes.append(
+            {
+                "from": "rejected",
+                "justification": after["classification_rationale"],
+                "predecessor_family": "9709.p5.representation_of_data",
+                "question_part_id": part_id,
+                "terminal_family": family_identity(shard),
+                "to": "approved",
+                "visual_refs": {
+                    "qp": after["visual_review"]["qp_page_refs"],
+                    "ms": after["visual_review"]["ms_page_refs"],
+                },
+            }
+        )
+    gap_row = rows[GAP_QUESTION]
+    for node in gap_row["structural_nodes"]:
+        part_id = f"{GAP_QUESTION}::{node['owner_path']}"
+        part = gap_part(part_id, node, active[GAP_QUESTION], gap_row)
+        by_id[part_id] = part
+        shard = GAP_ROUTES.get(part_id, ("P5-03", ""))[0]
+        family_by_part[part_id] = family_identity(shard)
+        changes.append(
+            {
+                "from": "unenriched",
+                "justification": part["classification_rationale"],
+                "predecessor_family": None,
+                "question_part_id": part_id,
+                "terminal_family": family_by_part[part_id],
+                "to": part["status"],
+                "visual_refs": {
+                    "qp": part["visual_review"]["qp_page_refs"],
+                    "ms": part["visual_review"]["ms_page_refs"],
+                },
+            }
+        )
+    require(set(by_id) == structural_part_ids, "terminal QuestionPart coverage drift")
+
+    instances = [
+        deepcopy(item)
+        for boundary in boundaries.values()
+        for item in boundary["procedure_instances"]
+    ]
+    steps = [
+        deepcopy(item)
+        for boundary in boundaries.values()
+        for item in boundary["procedure_step_instances"]
+    ]
+    for part_id, (shard, route) in {**RECLAIMED, **GAP_ROUTES}.items():
+        new_instances, new_steps = make_instances(by_id[part_id], shard, route)
+        instances.extend(new_instances)
+        steps.extend(new_steps)
+    for instance in instances:
+        identity = instance["procedure_model_ref"]
+        if identity in CANONICAL_MODEL_DEFINITIONS:
+            instance["procedure_model"] = {
+                "definition": CANONICAL_MODEL_DEFINITIONS[identity],
+                "procedure_model_id": identity,
+            }
+
+    status_names = ("approved", "candidate", "abstain", "rejected")
+    terminal = deepcopy(projection)
+    terminal["release_version"] = "p5-terminal-v1"
+    terminal["schema_version"] = "9709_p5_terminal_cumulative_projection_v1"
+    for status in status_names:
+        terminal["status_boundaries"][status] = {
+            "question_parts": sorted(
+                (item for item in by_id.values() if item["status"] == status),
+                key=lambda item: item["question_part_id"],
+            ),
+            "procedure_instances": sorted(
+                (item for item in instances if item["status"] == status),
+                key=lambda item: item["procedure_instance_id"],
+            ),
+            "procedure_step_instances": sorted(

+                key=lambda item: item["procedure_step_instance_id"],
+            ),

+    terminal["predecessor_projection"] = receipt(ACTIVE_PROJECTION)
+    terminal["summary"] = {
+        status: {
+            "question_parts": len(terminal["status_boundaries"][status]["question_parts"]),
+            "procedure_instances": len(terminal["status_boundaries"][status]["procedure_instances"]),
+            "procedure_step_instances": len(
+                terminal["status_boundaries"][status]["procedure_step_instances"]
+            ),
+        }
+        for status in status_names
+    }

+def validate_projection(projection: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    parts = [
+        item
+        for boundary in projection["status_boundaries"].values()
+        for item in boundary["question_parts"]
+    ]
+    instances = [
+        item
+        for boundary in projection["status_boundaries"].values()
+        for item in boundary["procedure_instances"]
+    ]
+    steps = [
+        item
+        for boundary in projection["status_boundaries"].values()
+        for item in boundary["procedure_step_instances"]
+    ]
+    part_ids = [item["question_part_id"] for item in parts]
+    instance_ids = [item["procedure_instance_id"] for item in instances]
+    step_ids = [item["procedure_step_instance_id"] for item in steps]
+    require(len(part_ids) == len(set(part_ids)) == EXPECTED["question_parts"], "duplicate/missing parts")
+    require(len(instance_ids) == len(set(instance_ids)), "duplicate ProcedureInstance")
+    require(len(step_ids) == len(set(step_ids)), "duplicate ProcedureStepInstance")
+    require(
+        all(item["question_part_id"] in set(part_ids) for item in instances),
+        "dangling ProcedureInstance",
+    )
+    require(
+        all(item["procedure_instance_id"] in set(instance_ids) for item in steps),
+        "dangling ProcedureStepInstance",
+    )
+    by_instance: dict[str, list[int]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for item in steps:
+        by_instance[item["procedure_instance_id"]].append(item["sequence_index"])
+    require(
+        all(sorted(value) == list(range(1, len(value) + 1)) for value in by_instance.values()),
+        "branch-scoped ProcedureStep sequence drift",
+    )
+    role_counts = Counter(item["role"] for item in parts)
+    require(role_counts["score_owning"] == EXPECTED["score_owning"], "score owner drift")
+    require(role_counts["instruction_only"] == EXPECTED["instruction_only"], "instruction owner drift")
+    statuses = Counter(item["status"] for item in parts)
+    require(
+        statuses == Counter({"approved": 476, "candidate": 732, "rejected": 23, "abstain": 397}),
+        f"terminal status drift: {statuses}",
+    )
+    approved_instances = [item for item in instances if item["status"] == "approved"]
+    approved_models = {item["procedure_model_ref"] for item in approved_instances}
+    candidate_models = {
+        item["procedure_model_ref"] for item in instances if item["status"] == "candidate"
+    }
+    canonical_models: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    canonical_types: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    for item in instances:
+        model = item["procedure_model"]
+        identity = item["procedure_model_ref"]
+        value = canonical_bytes(model)
+        require(
+            identity not in canonical_models or canonical_models[identity] == value,
+            f"conflicting ProcedureModel definition: {identity}",
+        )
+        canonical_models[identity] = value
+    for item in parts:
+        if not item.get("question_type"):
+            continue
+        question_type = item["question_type"]
+        identity = question_type["question_type_id"]
+        value = canonical_bytes(question_type)
+        require(
+            identity not in canonical_types or canonical_types[identity] == value,
+            f"conflicting QuestionType definition: {identity}",
+        )
+        canonical_types[identity] = value
+    supporting_candidate_signatures = [
+        (
+            item["question_part_id"],
+            item["procedure_model_ref"],
+            item["branch_key"],
+            item["role"],
+            item["status"],
+        )
+        for item in instances
+        if item["role"] == "supporting" and item["status"] == "candidate"
+    ]
+    require(
+        len(supporting_candidate_signatures)
+        == len(set(supporting_candidate_signatures)),
+        "duplicate supporting ProcedureInstance candidate",
+    )
+    return {
+        "alternative_branch_count": len(
+            {
+                (item["question_part_id"], item["branch_key"])
+                for item in instances
+                if item.get("alternative_to")
+            }
+        ),
+        "approved_procedure_instance_count": len(approved_instances),
+        "approved_procedure_model_count": len(approved_models),
+        "approved_procedure_reuse_ratio": round(
+            len(approved_instances) / len(approved_models), 6
+        ),
+        "candidate_only_procedure_model_count": len(candidate_models - approved_models),
+        "candidate_only_procedure_model_refs": sorted(candidate_models - approved_models),
+        "procedure_instance_count": len(instances),
+        "procedure_model_count": len({item["procedure_model_ref"] for item in instances}),
+        "procedure_step_instance_count": len(steps),
+        "question_type_count": len(
+            {
+                item["question_type"]["question_type_id"]
+                for item in parts
+                if item.get("question_type")
+            }
+        ),
+        "supporting_procedure_instance_count": sum(
+            item["role"] == "supporting" for item in instances
+        ),
+        "status_counts": dict(sorted(statuses.items())),
+    }

+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()

+def receipt(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    target = ROOT / path
+    return {
+        "byte_length": target.stat().st_size,
+        "path": path.as_posix(),
+        "sha256": sha256_file(target),
+    }

+def object_receipt(name: str, document: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    value = canonical_bytes(document)
+    return {
+        "byte_length": len(value),
+        "path": (OUT / name).as_posix(),

+def authenticate_inputs() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    records = []

+            actual = receipt(path)
+            require(
+                actual["sha256"] == family[f"{kind}_sha256"],
+                f"{family['shard']} {kind} byte custody drift",
+            )
+            records.append({"role": f"{family['shard']}_{kind}", **actual})
+    for current, successor in zip(FAMILIES, FAMILIES[1:], strict=False):
+        require(
+            current["merge_sha"] == successor["base_sha"],
+            "P5 successor chain is not contiguous",
+        )

+        [
+            {"role": "active_inventory", **receipt(ACTIVE_INVENTORY)},
+            {"role": "active_projection", **receipt(ACTIVE_PROJECTION)},
+            {"role": "active_manifest", **receipt(ACTIVE_MANIFEST)},

+    by_id = {item["question_part_id"]: item for item in parts}

+        shard, _ = RECLAIMED[part_id]
+        family_by_part[part_id] = family_identity(shard)
+        changes.append(
+            {

+                "justification": after["classification_rationale"],
+                "predecessor_family": "9709.p5.representation_of_data",
+                "question_part_id": part_id,
+                "terminal_family": family_identity(shard),

+
+    instances = [
+        deepcopy(item)
+        for boundary in boundaries.values()
+        for item in boundary["procedure_instances"]
+    ]
+    steps = [
+        deepcopy(item)

+        for item in boundary["procedure_step_instances"]
+    ]

+        new_instances, new_steps = make_instances(by_id[part_id], shard, route)

+    for status in status_names:

+            "procedure_instances": sorted(

+    terminal["summary"] = {

+            "procedure_instances": len(terminal["status_boundaries"][status]["procedure_instances"]),
+            "procedure_step_instances": len(

+def validate_projection(projection: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    parts = [
+        item
+        for boundary in projection["status_boundaries"].values()
+        for item in boundary["question_parts"]
+    ]
+    instances = [
+        item
+        for boundary in projection["status_boundaries"].values()
+        for item in boundary["procedure_instances"]
+    ]
+    steps = [
+        item
+        for boundary in projection["status_boundaries"].values()
+        for item in boundary["procedure_step_instances"]
+    ]
+    part_ids = [item["question_part_id"] for item in parts]
+    instance_ids = [item["procedure_instance_id"] for item in instances]
+    step_ids = [item["procedure_step_instance_id"] for item in steps]
+    require(len(part_ids) == len(set(part_ids)) == EXPECTED["question_parts"], "duplicate/missing parts")
+    require(len(instance_ids) == len(set(instance_ids)), "duplicate ProcedureInstance")
+    require(len(step_ids) == len(set(step_ids)), "duplicate ProcedureStepInstance")
+    require(
+        all(item["question_part_id"] in set(part_ids) for item in instances),
+        "dangling ProcedureInstance",
+    )
+    require(
+        all(item["procedure_instance_id"] in set(instance_ids) for item in steps),
+        "dangling ProcedureStepInstance",
+    )
+    by_instance: dict[str, list[int]] = defaultdict(list)
+    for item in steps:
+        by_instance[item["procedure_instance_id"]].append(item["sequence_index"])
+    require(
+        all(sorted(value) == list(range(1, len(value) + 1)) for value in by_instance.values()),
+        "branch-scoped ProcedureStep sequence drift",
+    )
+    role_counts = Counter(item["role"] for item in parts)
+    require(role_counts["score_owning"] == EXPECTED["score_owning"], "score owner drift")
+    require(role_counts["instruction_only"] == EXPECTED["instruction_only"], "instruction owner drift")
+    statuses = Counter(item["status"] for item in parts)
+    require(
+        statuses == Counter({"approved": 476, "candidate": 732, "rejected": 23, "abstain": 397}),
+        f"terminal status drift: {statuses}",
+    )
+    approved_instances = [item for item in instances if item["status"] == "approved"]
+    approved_models = {item["procedure_model_ref"] for item in approved_instances}
+    candidate_models = {
+        item["procedure_model_ref"] for item in instances if item["status"] == "candidate"
+    }
+    canonical_models: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    canonical_types: dict[str, bytes] = {}
+    for item in instances:
+        model = item["procedure_model"]
+        identity = item["procedure_model_ref"]
+        value = canonical_bytes(model)
+        require(
+            identity not in canonical_models or canonical_models[identity] == value,
+            f"conflicting ProcedureModel definition: {identity}",
+        )
+        canonical_models[identity] = value
+    for item in parts:
+        if not item.get("question_type"):
+            continue
+        question_type = item["question_type"]
+        identity = question_type["question_type_id"]
+        value = canonical_bytes(question_type)
+        require(
+            identity not in canonical_types or canonical_types[identity] == value,
+            f"conflicting QuestionType definition: {identity}",
+        )
+        canonical_types[identity] = value
+    supporting_candidate_signatures = [
+        (
+            item["question_part_id"],
+            item["procedure_model_ref"],
+            item["branch_key"],
+            item["role"],
+            item["status"],
+        )
+        for item in instances
+        if item["role"] == "supporting" and item["status"] == "candidate"
+    ]
+    require(
+        len(supporting_candidate_signatures)
+        == len(set(supporting_candidate_signatures)),
+        "duplicate supporting ProcedureInstance candidate",
+    )
+    return {
+        "alternative_branch_count": len(
+            {
+                (item["question_part_id"], item["branch_key"])
+                for item in instances
+                if item.get("alternative_to")
+            }
+        ),
+        "approved_procedure_instance_count": len(approved_instances),
+        "approved_procedure_model_count": len(approved_models),
+        "approved_procedure_reuse_ratio": round(
+            len(approved_instances) / len(approved_models), 6
+        ),
+        "candidate_only_procedure_model_count": len(candidate_models - approved_models),
+        "candidate_only_procedure_model_refs": sorted(candidate_models - approved_models),
+        "procedure_instance_count": len(instances),
+        "procedure_model_count": len({item["procedure_model_ref"] for item in instances}),
+        "procedure_step_instance_count": len(steps),
+        "question_type_count": len(
+            {
+                item["question_type"]["question_type_id"]
+                for item in parts
+                if item.get("question_type")
+            }
+        ),
+        "supporting_procedure_instance_count": sum(
+            item["role"] == "supporting" for item in instances
+        ),
+        "status_counts": dict(sorted(statuses.items())),
+    }
